description: Live calendars: works on the real calendars people connected to the app. Finds time slots of the given length when every listed account is free, within each person's working hours, across Google, Outlook and Pyas calendars. Slot times are in UTC. The result says which working hours were used for each person, and partial is true when a calendar could not be read.

from.description: An ISO 8601 date and time, e.g. 2026-10-21T15:00:00Z (or with an offset).

timezone.description: IANA time zone that slots start on round times in, and that working hours fall back to. Slot times are still returned in UTC.

to.description: An ISO 8601 date and time, e.g. 2026-10-21T15:00:00Z (or with an offset).

name: find_meeting_times
title: Find times everyone is free
